Name: Fall Leaves
Author: waterice888
Description:
Add some fallen leaves on the ground in fall, and add cherry blossom petals to the ground in spring(the option file). The changes involve seven scenes: BusStop, Town, Forest, Mountain, Railroad, Backwoods and Woods. Each map can be enabled and disabled individually in the config.json file.


[b]Compatibility with other modules[/b]
Works on Vanilla maps and Stardew Valley Reimagined 3 maps.
If you install the mods that change the above 7 maps and this module at the same time, the scene can be strange.
If you already have SVE installed, you do not need to install this module because it comes with its own fallen leaves.


[b]Other mods in the images
[/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12204]MSaturn Floaties - Alternative Textures for Crab Pots[/url]
Paint the crabpots in the river to look like fallen leaves. It will look great to use with this module!
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9063]SH's Wild Animals[/url]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11809]Ribeena's Vehicles[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2927]Secret Woods Totoro (Ghibli)[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9189]Junimo Woods[/url]


[b]模组简介[/b]
秋季在地上添加落叶，春季在地上添加樱花花瓣（可选文件）。改变涉及边远森林（农场上方地图）、巴士站、煤矿森林（玛妮家）、深山（罗宾家）、铁路、小镇、秘密森林这7个地图。每个地图可以单独设置落叶是否出现。


[b]与其他模组的兼容性[/b]
适用于原版游戏地图，与星露谷重新幻想3兼容（包括它的户外新地图）；
如果安装了改变以上7个地图的模组，请谨慎安装本模组，场景可能会很奇怪；
如果安装了SVE，则不必安装本模组，因为它自带落叶。
